title: Zeus Arc GT / GTS Flow Sink Screens
description: The Flow Sink screen for your Zeus Arc GT is a normal wear and tear part and should be replaced when it is time to clean your Arc GT. Old and deformed Flow Sink screens should not be placed back into the unit. This pack of 5 Flow Sink Screens is identical to the Flow Sink screen that came with your Zeus Arc GT and is a perfect replacement when yours needs replacing.
